name: unison-kaggle
description: Run the frozen UNISON-StateBench v0.1 empirical workflow through Kaggle's official MCP server without modifying the benchmark oracle or corpus.

interface.shortDescription: Run UNISON empirical evaluation through Kaggle
interface.longDescription: Connects the UNISON-StateBench workflow to Kaggle's official MCP server. It snapshots the live Kaggle benchmark model catalog, freezes an exact model lineup, runs the frozen 162-call-per-model plan, preserves raw structured observations, and computes the eight UNISON metrics with confidence intervals and failure topology.
